77155-scepticism-and-animal-faith.title: Scepticism And Animal Faith
77155-scepticism-and-animal-faith.creator: Unknown
77155-scepticism-and-animal-faith.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. A philosopher is compelled to follow the maxim of epic poets and to plunge _in medias res_. The origin of things, if things have an origin, cannot be revealed to me, if revealed at all, until I have travelled very far from it, and many revolutions of the sun must precede my first dawn. The light as it appears hides the candle.

arxiv-2007-13159.title: Tag2Risk: Harnessing Social Music Tags for Characterizing Depression Risk
arxiv-2007-13159.description: Abstract Musical preferences have been considered a mirror of the self. In this age of Big Data, online music streaming services allow us to capture ecologically valid music listening behavior and provide a rich source of information to identify several user-specific aspects. Studies have shown musical engagement to be an indirect representation of internal states including internalized symptomatology and depression.

arxiv-2105-00435.title: Deeply virtual Compton scattering off Helium nuclei with positron beams
arxiv-2105-00435.creator: Sara Fucini, Mohammad Hattawy, Matteo Rinaldi, Sergio Scopetta
arxiv-2105-00435.description: Abstract Positron initiated deeply virtual Compton scattering (DVCS) off 4 He and 3 He nuclei is described. The way the so-called d − d- term could be obtained from the real part of the relevant Compton form factor is summarized, and the importance and novelty of this measurement is discussed.

arxiv-2208-06233.title: Dynamic Sensor Matching based on Geomagnetic Inertial Navigation
arxiv-2208-06233.creator: Simone Müller Leibniz Supercomputing Centre (LRZ) Boltzmannstrasse 1 85748 Garching bei München simone.mueller@lrz.de Dieter Kranzlmüller Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität (LMU) MNM-Team Oettingenstr. 67 80538 München kranzlmueller@ifi.lmu.de
arxiv-2208-06233.description: Abstract Optical sensors can capture dynamic environments and derive depth information in near real-time. The quality of these digital reconstructions is determined by factors like illumination, surface and texture conditions, sensing speed and other sensor characteristics as well as the sensor-object relations. Improvements can be obtained by using dynamically collected data from multiple sensors.

arxiv-2410-14239.title: Parallel Writing of Nested Data in Columnar Formats
arxiv-2410-14239.creator: Jonas Hahnfeld, Jakob Blomer, Thorsten Kollegger
arxiv-2410-14239.description: Abstract High Energy Physics (HEP) experiments, for example at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at CERN, store data at exabyte scale in sets of files. They use a binary columnar data format by the ROOT framework, that also transparently compresses the data. In this format, cells are not necessarily atomic but they may contain nested collections of variable size.

arxiv-2503-19109.title: Notes on Quantum Computing for Thermal Science
arxiv-2503-19109.creator: Pietro Asinari, Nada Alghamdi, Paolo De Angelis, Giulio Barletta, Giovanni Trezza, Marina Provenzano, Matteo Maria Piredda, Matteo Fasano, Eliodoro Chiavazzo
arxiv-2503-19109.description: Abstract This document explores the potential of quantum computing for solving linear systems of interest in engineering. In particular, we focus on heat conduction as a paradigmatic example in thermal science. Conceived as a living document, it will be continuously updated with experimental findings and insights for the research community in Thermal Science.

arxiv-2510-05346.title: Exact Quench Dynamics from Thermal Pure Quantum States
arxiv-2510-05346.creator: Hui-Huang Chen
arxiv-2510-05346.description: Abstract We present an exact solution for the real-time dynamics following a quench from a thermal pure quantum (TPQ) state in an integrable system. Although equilibration is expected in this setting because the TPQ state already encodes the thermal expectation values of all conserved quantities, the approach to equilibrium shows highly nontrivial coherent dynamics.

Time series analysis of fossil biodiversity of marine invertebrates in the Paleobiology Database (PBDB) shows a significant periodicity at approximately 63 My, in agreement with previous analyses based on the Sepkoski database. pmc-10824842.title: Inflammation and poverty as individual and combined predictors of 15-year mortality risk in middle aged and older adults in the US
pmc-10824842.creator: Arch G. Mainous, Frank A. Orlando, Lu Yin, Pooja Sharma, Velyn Wu, Aaron Saguil
pmc-10824842.description: BackgroundChronic systemic inflammation and poverty are both linked to an increased mortality risk. The goal of this study was to determine if there is a synergistic effect of the presence of inflammation and poverty on the 15-year risk of all-cause, heart disease and cancer mortality among US adults.

pmc-11385094.title: Emergence of dysfunctional neutrophils with a defect in arginase-1 release in severe COVID-19
pmc-11385094.creator: Amrita Dwivedi, Aisling Ui Mhaonaigh, Makala Carroll, Bahareh Khosravi, Isabella Batten, Robert Seán Ballantine, Stuart Hendricken Phelan, Laura O’Doherty, Angel Mary George, Jacklyn Sui, Heike C. Hawerkamp, Padraic G. Fallon, Elnè Noppe, Sabina Mason, Niall Conlon, Clíona Ni Cheallaigh, Conor M. Fi
pmc-11385094.description: Neutrophilia occurs in patients infected with SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) and is predictive of poor outcomes. Here, we link heterogenous neutrophil populations to disease severity in COVID-19. We identified neutrophils with features of cellular aging and immunosuppressive capacity in mild COVID-19 and features of neutrophil immaturity and activation in severe disease.

pmc-11484108.title: Influence of parboiling conditions on rice grain quality characters and insect infestation with rice weevil (Sitophilus oryzae. L) of some rice cultivars
pmc-11484108.creator: Khaled M H Abd El Salam, Germine M Abou El-Soud, Abd El Salam M Marei, Khaled H M Abdel-Rheim, Ahmed Abdel‑Megeed, Sobhi F Lamlom
pmc-11484108.description: Parboiling improves rice grain hardness and reduces susceptibility to Sitophilus oryzae infestation by gelatinizing the starch and enhancing resistance.A newly designed electric machine was used to parboil four Egyptian rice cultivars—Sakha 108, Giza 178, Super 300, and Egyptian Yasmin—at 70, 75, and 80 °C and determine their susceptibility to Sitophilus oryzae L. (Coleoptera: Curculionidae) infestation.

pmc-11607518.title: Comparison of Sutureless Aortic Valve Replacement and Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Propensity Score Matching
pmc-11607518.creator: Shidong Liu, Hao Chen, Wenjun Zhou, Pengying Zhao, Liang Qi, Yalan Zhang, Bing Song, Cuntao Yu
pmc-11607518.description: Background:To evaluate the clinical outcomes of sutureless aortic valve replacement (SUAVR) and transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI).Methods:We systematically searched the electronic database and the Clinical Trials Registry up to 31 February 2023. Random effects model risk ratio (RR) and mean differences (MD) with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled for the clinical outcomes.

pmc-12443241.title: The GravyTrain toolbox for molecular cell biology
pmc-12443241.creator: Oren Shatz, Zvulun Elazar, Mojtaba Kordrostami, Mojtaba Kordrostami, Mojtaba Kordrostami, Mojtaba Kordrostami
pmc-12443241.description: Yeast genetics has the power for thorough investigation of complex systems in molecular cell biology. Here, we present GravyTrain, a comprehensive repository of constructs for genomic modifications, including gene deletions or tagging with fusion tags for robust protein characterization and manipulation.

pmc-12758262.title: Frontline sigvotatug vedotin plus pembrolizumab vs pembrolizumab for non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 tumor proportion score ≥50%: phase III study design
pmc-12758262.creator: Martin Reck, Shun Lu, Kenneth J. O’Byrne, Carlos Barrios, Dmitri Pavlov, Fabian Tay, Marcelo V. Negrao
pmc-12758262.description: Integrin beta-6 (IB6) is a tumor-associated membrane protein involved in many cellular processes, including wound healing and tissue remodeling. While IB6 expression is constitutively low in healthy tissues, high IB6 expression in numerous cancers, including non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), is associated with poor outcomes.

pmc-12984078.title: Torture and healthcare service utilization in Syrian refugees resettled in Norway – a longitudinal, registry-based study
pmc-12984078.creator: Alexander Nissen, Katharina Haag
pmc-12984078.description: Background: Torture, banned under international treaties such as the UN Convention Against Torture, remains a widespread violation with profound health consequences. The Istanbul Protocol (IP) sets global standards for the medical documentation of torture highlighting the important role of healthcare providers.

pmc-13677788.title: Primary Intratesticular glomus tumor: a rare mesenchymal neoplasm and a diagnostic challenge
pmc-13677788.creator: Zahra Aminparast, Payam Nikjo, Donya Rahmati, Paria Nikjo
pmc-13677788.description: Background: Glomus tumors are rare mesenchymal neoplasms of perivascular origin, most commonly found in the dermis or subcutis of distal extremities. Testicular involvement is exceptionally uncommon and poses a diagnostic challenge due to histopathologic similarities with other intratesticular tumors. Case Presentation: We describe an 85-year-old man with a painless, gradually enlarging left testicular mass. Imaging and tumor markers were inconclusive.
